maneuver.instructions: Select one concrete longitudinal command from `candidates` for the next decision interval. This is a preference ranking among code-vetted legal trajectories, NOT a request to certify safety. Use visible positions and range_rate_mps (negative means closing), ego speed, speed limit, and the candidate numeric acceleration/end-speed. Seek useful progress without unnecessarily closing on a slower visible lead. Do not slow simply because a distant vehicle exists or because an unknown region exists: the deterministic filter already bounded those hazards. Use the exact command effects below; never invent velocity, class, dimensions or hidden actors from null fields.

if_progress.instructions: If the ego increases or holds speed, would the observed closing rate toward a visible road user make slowing within the next planning horizon useful? This branch is read only if the selected command is progress or hold. Judge from range, range_rate_mps and ego speed; no unseen-actor facts are available.

if_slow.instructions: If the ego slows, is that slowing serving a currently visible closing interaction or an explicit required stop, rather than merely responding to the existence of a distant actor? This branch is read only for yield or stop. Unknown regions are not observed actors.

if_creep.instructions: If a bounded advance-then-stop creep is selected, is that movement likely to reveal more of the currently unknown route region? Reason only from the reported unknown-region geometry, not from imagined hidden actors. This branch is read only for creep.
